deep_observation: 原文 no reprieve（无喘息、无宽赦）被译成「没有重复」，语义完全错误且与上下文矛盾。证据：tome 组件 game/modules/tome/data/birth/worlds.lua:126 @commit 624a67329fe2ad440c5b344785a9c73fcf22ae63，Infinite Dungeon 的 locked_desc 四个短语 Ever deeper / never ending / no reprieve / keep descending 均描述无休止下行，无任何「重复」义；应为「没有喘息」一类。
source: Ever deeper, never ending, no reprieve, keep descending. In ruins old, through barred gate, once riddle solved, find thy fate.
surface_observation: 原文“no reprieve”意为没有喘息或缓解，译成“没有重复”属于明显错译。
target: 无尽深度，没有终点，没有重复，不断深入，在古老的废墟里，穿过关闭的大门，解开谜题，寻找你的宿命。

deep_observation: sneakthief 被译为「刺客」，引入原文没有的暗杀语义。补查证据：tome 组件 game/modules/tome/data/general/objects/egos/rings.lua:358-372 @commit 624a67329fe2ad440c5b344785a9c73fcf22ae63，该条目为 power_source={technique=true} 的 greater_ego 双属性前缀，wielder 只给 combat_atk 与 STAT_DEX/STAT_CUN 加成，与紧邻并列的 gladiator's（STR/CON）同属「双属性」系列，完全没有暗杀、致命一击或潜行击杀机制。sneakthief 指潜行窃贼/扒手，译作「刺客」既偏离词义，又与游戏中独立存在的 assassin 系命名存在撞车风险。
surface_observation: sneakthief 指窃贼，译为“刺客”改变了人物含义。

source:
Deploy a noisy lure that attracts all creatures within radius %d to it for %d turns.
		It has %d life (based on your Cunning) and is very durable, with %d armor and %d%% resistance to non-physical damage.

target:
抛出一个诱饵来吸引 %d 码半径内的敌人，持续 %d 回合。
		诱饵有 %d 生命（基于灵巧），且非常坚韧，拥有 %d 护甲和 %d%% 非物理伤害抗性。
		在等级 5 时，当诱饵被摧毁时，它会触发其周围 2 码范围内的部分陷阱（请查看各陷阱自身的说明，以确认其是否会被触发）。
		此技能不会打断潜行状态。

source: You rise to meet the pain that others would inflict on you. Every turn you take damage, your Strength and Willpower increase until they reach a maximum of +%d after 5 turns. Any turn in which you do not take damage will reduce the bonus. While in effect, your body also has a %d%% chance to overcome poisons and diseases each turn.
target:
你勇于面对其他人带给你的痛苦。每回合当你承受伤害时，你将会增加你的力量和意志，直至在 5 回合后增加至最大值 +%d。
		每个你不承受伤害的回合会降低该增益效果。
		当此效果激活时，每回合你有 %d%% 的概率抵抗毒素和疾病效果。

source:
An archer from the northern lands
Claimed of his great renown
With peerless skill and countless trials
His name known town to town

He spoke of facing vampire lords
Who promised years of pain
The archer gave a stern retort
An arrow through the brain

A fighter from the southern lands
Claimed armies fled his might
With dragons slain 'most every day
And demons crushed by night

He spoke of ancient sprawling ruins
Home to a ghastly shade
Its years of madness, hate and rage
Were ended on his blade

An archmage from the western lands
Claimed kingdoms feared his name
With countless legends, songs and myths
Attesting to his fame

He spoke of fire, storm and hail
To match the fiercest wyrm
To see one man hold so much power
Can make an empire squirm

A rogue who came from unknown lands
Not known for anything
A leap, a flash, a concealed blade
Three heroes felt its sting

The archer dropped, his bow unplucked
The fighter died as well
The archmage found its poison
Far too potent to dispel

The rogue is unknown to this day
Though rumours persist still
Rogues aren't known by name or deed
But by the names they kill
target:
北方来了一射手，
自夸声名震四方；
绝技在身经百战，
城城镇镇知其名。

他说曾战吸血领主，
对方扬言折磨多年；
射手只作冷冷一答：
利箭径直贯穿脑间。

南方来了一名战士，
自称雄威吓退万军；
白日屠龙稀松平常，
入夜灭魔势若扫尘。

他说曾入绵延古迹，
那里盘踞骇人幽影；
多年疯狂、仇恨、暴怒，
尽数终结于他剑锋。

西方来了一位大法师，
自称诸国闻名胆寒；
无数传奇、歌谣、神话，
都为他的威名作传。

他说烈火、风暴、冰雹，
足以匹敌最凶巨龙；
一人手握如此伟力，
整个帝国也会惶恐。

不知何处来了个盗贼，
从来没有半点声名；
一跃、一闪、一把暗刃，
三位英雄同时中招。

射手倒地，弓弦未响；
战士随后也丧了命；
大法师才发觉毒性，
猛烈得根本无法驱净。

至今无人知晓盗贼是谁，
尽管传闻仍未停息；
盗贼不以姓名事迹闻名，
只以被他杀死者之名传世。

deep_observation: 机制被改写。原文 reduces duration of detrimental physical effects by up to 5% per point 意为「每点最多减少 5%」，译文「每超过1点减少5%」凭空引入原文不存在的「超过」阈值，同时丢失 up to（最多）这一上限限定，读者会理解成线性且无上限的削减。另 depending on the power of the opponent's effect（取决于对方效果的强度）被译作「基于目标强度判定后」，把对方效果强度换成了「目标强度」，主体与量纲均偏移。证据：tome 组件 game/modules/tome/class/interface/TooltipsData.lua:330-332 @commit 624a67329fe2ad440c5b344785a9c73fcf22ae63；同文件 334 行的 Spell saving throw 使用完全相同句式，可对照。
source:
#GOLD#Physical saving throw#LAST#
Increases chance to shrug off physically-induced effects.  Also reduces duration of detrimental physical effects by up to 5% per point, depending on the power of the opponent's effect.
surface_observation: 原文“up to 5% per point”表示每点最多减少5%，译文“每超过1点减少5%”遗漏上限限定，表述为固定减少5%。
target:
#GOLD#物理豁免#LAST#
增加你摆脱物理效果的几率。此外，基于目标强度判定后，每超过1点减少5%不良物理状态持续时间。

target: 用嘲弄的语调书写的小纸片。

source: A formation of purple crystal, but where the others could only be described as polyhedral, this construct seems to strangely resemble... you, if you were much, much larger.
target: 一种紫色水晶，如果其他水晶可以被定义为多面体的话，那么这个水晶只能说……和你一样，如果你大个几倍的话。

source: This fiery robe was worn by the mad pyromancer Halchot, who terrorised many towns in the late Age of Dusk, burning and looting villages as they tried to recover from the Spellblaze.  Eventually he was tracked down by the Ziguranth, who cut out his tongue, chopped off his head, and rent his body to shreds.  The head was encased in a block of ice and paraded through the streets of nearby towns amidst the cheers of the locals.  Only this robe remains of the flames of Halchot.
target: 这件炙热的长袍曾属于疯狂的烈焰术士哈克特。黄昏纪末期，他恐吓过许多城镇，在人们努力从魔法大爆炸中恢复之际烧杀抢掠村庄。最终他被伊格兰斯捕获了。伊格兰斯割下他的舌头，砍掉他的脑袋，并把他的身体撕成小块。他的脑袋被封在一个大冰块里，并且在附近城镇的居民欢庆中进行了游街。只有这件长袍从哈克特的烈焰中保留了下来。

deep_observation: Feed Strengths 译为「腐蚀吸食」，丢失宾语并引入源文与机制都不存在的意象。补查证据：tome 组件 game/modules/tome/data/talents/cursed/dark-sustenance.lua:182-199 @commit 624a67329fe2ad440c5b344785a9c73fcf22ae63，该天赋为 cursed/dark-sustenance 第 4 级被动，getResistGain 配合 info 文本 reducing your targeted foe's resistances, multiplying them by %0.2f and increasing your resistances by the amount drained，即抽取并转移目标抗性；同文件同系列另有第 1 级 Feed（183 行上文）与第 3 级 Feed Power。译名既未体现 Strengths（被抽取的抗性/长处），也未保持 Feed 系列的并列结构，且「腐蚀」在本作中对应酸性/侵蚀类伤害概念，与本天赋无关，属术语误植。
surface_observation: 原文 Feed Strengths 表示吸食力量，译文“腐蚀吸食”把 Strengths 的力量含义替换成了腐蚀。

deep_observation: preserve the past 被译成「平衡过去」，语义错误。证据：tome 组件 game/modules/tome/data/birth/classes/chronomancer.lua:152 @commit 624a67329fe2ad440c5b344785a9c73fcf22ae63，该句是 Temporal Warden 的 locked_desc，preserve ... to protect 的结构强调「保存/守护过去以护佑未来」，与「平衡」无关；而「平衡」在时空法师体系中另有 Paradox/时间线平衡的专门含义，此处误用会造成概念混淆。
source: We preserve the past to protect the future. The hands of time are guarded by the arms of war.
surface_observation: 原文 preserve the past 表示保护或保全过去，译文“平衡过去”改变了动作含义。
target: 我们平衡过去，守护未来，我们用战斗来维持时间的秩序。

source:
We both know the strength of the arcane; we both hunger for power. There is so much I have discovered, so much I could teach you.
This place is special. The veil of reality is thin here, forever shattered by the Spellblaze. We are taking advantage of this; we can draw on the power,
leeching from this place, to better ourselves, to bring forth the dominion of magic!
target:
我们都深知奥术的力量，也都渴求力量。我探索出了许多奥秘，有太多的东西可以传授给你。
这个地方非同寻常。这里的现实帷幕无比脆弱，已被魔法大爆炸永久撕碎。我们正善加利用这一点；我们可以汲取其中的力量，
从此处不断榨取，以提升我们自身，迎来魔法的统治！

deep_observation: missile launcher 译为「导弹发射器」，把奇幻设定中的远程发射武器误作现代武器。补查证据：tome 组件 game/modules/tome/data/talents/techniques/techniques.lua:325-335 @commit 624a67329fe2ad440c5b344785a9c73fcf22ae63 的 archeryWeaponCheck，同一消息表中 no shooter 分支的默认武器名为 _t 字面量 missile launcher，而 incompatible missile launcher 分支的默认 weapon_type 为 _t 字面量 bow，可见 missile launcher 是弓、投石索这类发射弹药的远程武器的统称（与 ammo 配对使用），并非导弹发射器。
source: Your ammo is incompatible with your missile launcher.
surface_observation: 原文 missile launcher 指发射弹药的远程武器，译为“导弹发射器”将 missile 的投射物含义误限定为导弹。
target: 你的弹药类型与导弹发射器不匹配。
